id: title:jurajmajerik:reject deleted cohorts when building a cohort property filter

review.posthog_relevance: Prevents runtime exceptions and incorrect cohort membership when HogQL property-to-expr stage supplies an ID for a deleted cohort, relying on HogQL's existing skip behavior.
review.reason: Adds a deleted=False filter to Cohort.objects.get() and updates comments. This prevents cohort lookups from returning deleted records, which could otherwise cause downstream query errors or incorrect cohort membership. The comment notes that HogQL already skips deleted cohorts, so this check is required at the HogQL property-to-expr stage to avoid exceptions when a cohort ID is-sup
review.uncertainty: This tier is assigned because the change is a localized, bounded correctness improvement. No broader systemic capability or unverified benefit is demonstrated. The tier is not assigned for the test hunks, which do not establish a tier.

observations.behavior: Adds deleted=False filter to Cohort.objects.get() and updates comments.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents cohort lookups from returning deleted records, which could otherwise cause downstream query errors or incorrect cohort membership.
